library.title: Library
library.name: Name
library.deliveryOnly: Delivery-only library: the encoding ladder cannot be changed.
library.confirmDeleteText: The library “{name}” and all its videos will be permanently deleted.
library.ladderChangedHint: The encoding ladder applies to new uploads. Use “Reprocess videos” to update existing videos.
library.reprocessConfirmText: Videos in “{name}” will be reprocessed with the current settings. Qualities that are already finished are kept; only missing or failed ones are created. “Re-encode all qualities” also recreates finished ones. This may take a while.
library.qualityHelp: Performance: compact files, fast start. Quality: visibly sharper, about 2.5–3× the CDN traffic.
library.qualityApplyNote: Changing the quality mode only applies to existing videos after “Reprocess videos” with “Re-encode all qualities”; new uploads use it right away.
library.qualityChangedHint: The quality mode was changed. Videos that are already processed keep their files until they are reprocessed with "Re-encode all qualities".
library.qualityReprocessHint: Quality mode saved. To apply it to existing videos, run "Reprocess" with "Re-encode all qualities".

cms.label: VideoOptimizer video
cms.autoplayHint: Autoplay only works together with "Muted" (browser policy).
cms.formatHint: A fixed format crops the video to fill the area (portrait formats are limited to 420 px width).
cms.focalHint: Which part stays visible when the video is cropped. Not supported by the hosted embed.

backgroundHero.label: VideoOptimizer Background hero
backgroundHero.headline: Headline
backgroundHero.priorityHint: Loads the background video with priority when the hero starts in the viewport.

gallery.uploadStarted: Upload started – the video is being processed.
gallery.ingestStarted: Import started – the video is being processed.
gallery.processingTimeout: Processing takes longer than expected. Reload the list later to see the finished video.
gallery.confirmDeleteText: “{title}” will be permanently deleted at VideoOptimizer. This cannot be undone.
gallery.ingestUrlHelp: Public https link to the video file itself, e.g. https://example.com/video.mp4.
gallery.ingestPlatform: Links to video pages such as YouTube cannot be imported. Please use a link to the video file itself.
gallery.selectedMissing: The selected video no longer exists in VideoOptimizer. Choose another video to replace it.

detail.posterFailed: The custom preview image could not be processed.
detail.posterTimeout: Processing the preview image is taking longer than expected.
detail.playerUnavailable: The video cannot be played here.
detail.posterInvalidType: Please choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
detail.mediaFetchFailed: The image could not be loaded from the media library.

apiNotice.tokenMissing: No VideoOptimizer API token is configured.
apiNotice.invalidBaseUrl: The VideoOptimizer API URL in the plugin configuration is invalid.
apiNotice.tokenRejected: The VideoOptimizer API token was rejected (expired or revoked).
apiNotice.privilege: Your user lacks the "View" permission for VideoOptimizer (Settings → Users & permissions → Roles).
apiNotice.unavailable: VideoOptimizer data could not be loaded.

subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.noLanguages: Add a subtitle language in the "Subtitle languages" card first.
subtitles.uploadedSkipped: Subtitle uploaded; {count} malformed cue was skipped. | Subtitle uploaded; {count} malformed cues were skipped.
subtitles.replaces: The video already has a subtitle in this language; the upload replaces it.
subtitles.fileInvalid_type: Only .vtt and .srt files can be uploaded.
subtitles.fileInvalid_size: The subtitle file must not be larger than 2 MB.
subtitles.confirmDeleteText: Delete the {language} subtitle of this video?

subtitleLanguages.title: Subtitle languages
subtitleLanguages.subtitle: Subtitles can only be uploaded in these languages; they appear in this order in the player menu.
subtitleLanguages.codeHelp: BCP 47, e.g. de, en-US or de-x-simple. Cannot be changed later.
subtitleLanguages.label: Label
subtitleLanguages.labelHelp: Shown in the player menu. Without a label the language's own name is used.
subtitleLanguages.inUse: {count} video still has a subtitle in {language}. Delete that subtitle first. | {count} videos still have a subtitle in {language}. Delete those subtitles first.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.hint: Your own key/value data on the video, for example the ID of the entry it belongs to. Up to 10 keys.
metadata.problem_keyInvalid: A key has 1-40 characters of a-z, 0-9, "_", "." and "-" (lower case) and starts with a letter or digit.
metadata.problem_keyDuplicate: Each key can only be used once.
metadata.problem_valueTooLong: A value has at most 64 characters.
metadata.problem_tooMany: At most 10 metadata keys are possible.

savings.title: Savings
savings.subtitle: What VideoOptimizer saves compared to serving your original files.
savings.noTraffic: No CDN traffic data is available yet.
savings.noRange: No traffic data for this period.
savings.estimatedOriginal: Estimated traffic with the original files
savings.estimate: Bandwidth figures are estimates; video traffic is tracked since October 2026.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.subtitle: VideoOptimizer reports finished and failed videos here, so cached embeds and pages are refreshed at once.
webhook.urlHelp: Enter this URL in VideoOptimizer under Integrations, Webhooks. It uses the shop's base URL; if your storefront runs on another domain, use that domain with the same path.
webhook.copyFailed: The URL could not be copied; select and copy it manually.
webhook.notConfigured: No webhook secret yet: set it in the plugin configuration (Webhook secret), otherwise deliveries are refused.
